PlanDefinition Wet (fluid-bed) granulation, blending, compression and film-coating. Commercial batch size 520.00 kg (approx. 2,600,000 tablets). No overages. Critical steps: granulation (step 3) and compression (step 8); granule particle size and uncoated tablet hardness are controlled within a design space to ensure dissolution.

resource.title: Manufacturing process of Sakura Bloom 20 mg film-coated tablets (Aparna Pharmaceutical Manufacturing)
resource.description: Wet (fluid-bed) granulation, blending, compression and film-coating. Commercial batch size 520.00 kg (approx. 2,600,000 tablets). No overages. Critical steps: granulation (step 3) and compression (step 8); granule particle size and uncoated tablet hardness are controlled within a design space to ensure dissolution.

action.title: Step 1 - Pre-blending
action.description: Blend 52.000 kg of cellulose, microcrystalline, 26.000 kg of croscarmellose sodium, 353.600 kg of lactose monohydrate and 52.000 kg of Sakuramil drug substance in a diffusion mixer (bin blender).

action.title: Step 2 - Preparation of granulation liquid
action.description: Dissolve 15.600 kg hydroxypropyl cellulose in purified water using a vessel with stirrer to prepare a granulation liquid free from lumps.

action.title: Step 3 - Granulation
action.description: Load the pre-blended material into a fluid bed granulator and add the granulation liquid to achieve wetting of pre-blended material and formation of granules.

action.title: Step 4 - Drying
action.description: Dry the granules using the dryer integrated within the fluid bed granulator unit until loss on drying of 1 - 2 % is achieved.

action.title: Step 5 - Screening
action.description: Sieve the dried granules using a screening mill.

action.title: Step 6 - Lubricant addition
action.description: Sieve 5.200 kg of magnesium stearate through a screen and add it to the granules.

action.title: Step 7 - Final blending
action.description: Blend the mixture using a diffusion mixer (bin blender) to obtain the final blend.

action.title: Step 8 - Tablet compression
action.description: Compress the final blend using a tablet press to obtain the tablet cores.

action.title: Step 9 - Preparation of the coating suspension
action.description: Prepare a homogeneous suspension of the Basic coating premix, red in purified water.

action.title: Step 10 - Film-coating
action.description: Film-coat the tablet cores using the film-coat suspension in a coating pan to achieve the desired film-coat weight gain, followed by drying.

action.title: Step 11 - Inspection
action.description: Collect 10 tablets to perform the Description test and Identification test (RTRT).

action.title: Step 12 - Primary packaging
action.description: The film-coated tablets are primary packaged (HDPE bottle or PA/AL/PVC blister).

action.title: Step 13 - Secondary packaging
action.description: The primary packaged product is packed in a cardboard-based secondary pack.
